Container.Name: KeibiDrop
Container.Overview:
Your Unraid box becomes the always-on peer of an encrypted peer-to-peer folder mount. Your computer mounts the shared folder with the KeibiDrop app and reads it on demand: only the bytes you touch move, end to end encrypted (hybrid post-quantum key exchange). No account, no cloud. The serving side needs no FUSE. MPL-2.0.
After the first start, open the container log: it prints this box's code and the three pairing steps.

Config.Name: Shared folder
Config.Description: The folder this box serves. Set the mode to read only to let the peer read and change nothing.

Config.Name: Identity and contacts
Config.Description: Holds this box's private identity key. Keep it out of shared backups.

Config.Name: Peer code
Config.Description: Your computer's 86-character code (Settings, Identity, in the KeibiDrop app). Leave empty to pair later from the container console with: kd add-contact laptop <code>

Config.Name: Peer name
Config.Description: Contact name for the peer code.

Config.Name: Read only share
Config.Description: true refuses every change the peer sends.

Config.Name: Inbound port
Config.Description: TCP port peers dial (26000 to 27000). Change only if another KeibiDrop peer on this box uses it.

Config.Name: Outbound port
Config.Description: TCP port this box dials from.

Config.Name: Strict mode
Config.Description: true never falls back to the bridge; the connection fails when no direct path exists.
